subject: Training on customer data - opt-out confirmation
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Training on customer data - opt-out confirmation

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — appreciate the walkthrough of AcmeFin's use case. Quick recap from our side and next steps so we can get this scoped into your Dedicated environment: 

Summary of requirements you stated:
- PII handling: all direct identifiers (SSNs, account numbers) will be redacted client-side prior to being sent to Redwood.
- Data residency: production inference and logs must remain in us-east-1.
- Retention: request to retain request/response logs for 90 days maximum.
- Logging controls: no user-level audit logs persisted beyond retention window; store only aggregated metrics unless explicitly required for debugging.
- Model training/improvement: AcmeFin requires that any content sent to Redwood NOT be used for model training or improvement (opt-out).

Attached is the draft opt-out form we discussed (acmefin_data_handling_request.pdf) — if you confirm the language we will prepare a signed copy on our side. Please confirm: 1) that the opt-out wording below matches your needs, and 2) the email and contact for your legal/compliance team to sign the final form.

Next steps (proposed):
- Jordan: confirm opt-out and countersign the attached form (today if possible)
- Neha (cc'd): will pull SOC 2 evidence and our data handling manifest for your security review once opt-out is confirmed
- Marissa (cc'd): will scope the implementation plan and update timeline (ETA for changes: ~3 business days after signed opt-out)

If anything above is off from what you expect, let me know and we can adjust.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Training on customer data - opt-out confirmation

Rachel — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the requirements you captured above are correct for AcmeFin.

Specifically: we require that any customer content sent to Redwood be excluded from model training/improvement (we do not want transcripts or prompts used to update models). Retention 90 days is acceptable. Data residency in us-east-1 is mandatory.

I've attached a signed opt-out form (ACME-Training-OptOut-20261018.pdf) for your records — this was signed by our Head of Compliance. Please confirm receipt and confirm when Neha can expect a request for SOC 2 artifacts.

Also copying security@acmefin.com for any follow-ups on evidence. Our legal team (legal@acmefin.com) will review any SOW language but we can share the signed opt-out now to unblock implementation.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Director, Product
AcmeFin
